name: Barañáin (Spain)
description: Blue field charged at the centre with the arms of Barañáin (a chevron and roundels on blue within a red bordure, timbred with a helmet and mantling).
history: Municipal flag of Barañáin; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
